verdict.rationale: Loops documents a domain setup step required before sending ("Set up your domain to start sending email"), and its Brevo migration guide includes a "verify your domain" step. This shows custom sending-domain authentication with verification exists, but the evidence gives no detail on what it covers. Missing for 10: explicit SPF, DKIM and DMARC alignment coverage, details of the guided DNS record setup, the verification status workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
